snippet.title: Aldmark Calls for Aid | Medieval Siege Defense Strategy Game | Free Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Light the beacons 🔥 Make safe the city ⚔️

Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5168960/Aldmark_Calls_for_Aid/ 

Aldmark Calls for Aid is a medieval siege-defence game with no base-building and no resource management. Command your troops directly, and between rounds choose where to light the beacons that call allies to your aid. Every battle earns renown, win or lose, to spend on unlocking and upgrading troops, enhancing your realm, strengthening your defences, and more. Maps are procedurally generated, each level bigger than the last, and victory doesn't have to be the end: keep fighting and see how long you can withstand the siege of Aldmark.

Music: “Swordstorm” by Roarback Studio

#indiegame #strategygame #medieval #siege #steamnextfest
